rationale: Stage one (sync1) feeds both sync2 and the early_seen register before the required depth. This is the early-fan-out defect that CDC-007 names: early_seen samples a possibly metastable first stage. The functional path through sync2 and dst_flag is clean.
caveats: early_seen is an internal register with no port and no keep attribute, so synthesis could remove it, even though the contract calls it a retained debug consumer. The defect is structural and its consumer is the debug path. The settlement relies on the contract's statement that it is retained. Exposing early_seen as a port would make the consumer observable, which would need a re-review.
CDC-029 is expected to be INFO here because the input is captured by a recognised chain. It must not earn detection credit.

Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.
